data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for Microsoft authentication via the native MSAL library.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to sign in with Microsoft accounts using native MSAL library for Android, iOS, and macOS. It supports single and multiple account modes, acquiring tokens interactively and silently, and integration with the Microsoft Authenticator app, browser, or webview.
use_when: You need Microsoft Entra ID (AAD) or B2C authentication in your Flutter app.
You want to use the native MSAL library for Android, iOS, and macOS.
avoid_when: You only need Google, Apple, or generic OAuth sign-in without Microsoft.
You want a pure Dart implementation without native mobile dependencies.
strengths: Uses official native MSAL libraries under the hood.
Supports both single and multiple account modes.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration in Azure Portal and native project files.
Platform-specific minimum version requirements (Android SDK 21+, iOS/macOS 16+/11+ depending on tooling).
data.setup_notes: Requires app registration in Azure Portal, platform-specific bundle/package configuration, signature hashes for Android, keychain sharing capabilities for iOS/macOS, and custom configuration JSON files.

alternatives.name: flutter_appauth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using AppAuth for OAuth2 / OpenID Connect authentication instead of MSAL-specific SDKs.
